mood: Elegant, cinematic, emotional, modern, luxury tourism, Netflix documentary style

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tight leading-none

typography.instruction: Do not use standard Inter. Use Cormorant Garamond for all headings. The H1 should feel like a cinematic documentary title.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Allow images to breathe. High visual impact with asymmetry.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-2) with a glow effect (shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(212,175,55,0.1)]). Text changes to high contrast.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade and slow slide up. Staggered reveals for gallery items.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_effects: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY. Parallax effects on large images. Sticky headers with backdrop blur.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Animated counters for 'Why Visit' section. Particle effects in the hero section.

components_strategy.buttons: Glassmorphic or solid Gold. No standard Shadcn primary blue. Example: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black hover:bg-[#F3E5AB] transition-colors rounded-none px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm.
components_strategy.cards: Use 'Crystal Glass' variant. bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10. Nested radii (max rounded-2xl).
components_strategy.navigation: Sticky floating nav. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 border-b border-white/10. Must have language switcher (ES/FR/EN).
components_strategy.timeline: Vertical line with glowing gold dots. Cards alternating left and right on desktop.
components_strategy.map: Minimalist interactive SVG map or dark mode Framer Motion custom map with glowing emerald pins for cities.

hero.usage: Fullscreen hero background. Apply bg-black/40 overlay.

abstract_flag.usage: Background texture for History or Loading screen.

famous_people.name: Emir Abdelkader
famous_people.description: Líder histórico y símbolo de la resistencia.

sections_breakdown.hero: Fullscreen height. Cinematic Sahara image. Overlay gradient. Massive 'ARGELIA' heading. Scroll down arrow indicator.
sections_breakdown.history: Animated timeline (Bereber -> Roman -> Ottoman -> French -> Independence). Subtle flag abstract background.
sections_breakdown.famous_people: Horizontal bento or slider with glassmorphism cards. On hover, show info.
sections_breakdown.landscapes: Staggered image grid (Parallax). Tall and square aspect ratios.
sections_breakdown.gastronomy: Elegant cards combining macro food shots with dark overlays and gold typography.
sections_breakdown.why_visit: Metrics grid. Animated counters (e.g., 1.5M Martyrs, 10th Largest Country).
sections_breakdown.map: Interactive points of interest mapping to the landscapes.
sections_breakdown.footer: Massive text 'ARGELIA' in background. 'Presentado por Houari' in center. Social links.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'framer-motion' for all animations, reveals, and parallax.
Install and use 'lucide-react' or '@phosphor-icons/react' for elegant thin icons.
Apply 'Cormorant Garamond' from Google Fonts to index.css and use it for all major headings.
Ensure the hero image has an overlay (e.g. bg-black/40) so the white text 'ARGELIA' is perfectly legible.
Use glassmorphism utilities defined in 'surface' for cards. Do NOT use standard flat Shadcn cards.
Include a language switcher UI in the header (ES, FR, EN).
Ensure it is fully responsive, as it will be shown via QR code.
Use the specific media URLs provided. Do not use generic placeholders.
